package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestProjectAuthoringFlowTransitionShapeAndPublicationBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	flow := projectAuthoringFlowFixture(t)
	if flow.Status != ProjectAuthoringProposed || flow.TZAuthoringJobID != "" || flow.Publication != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected proposed flow: %#v", flow)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(flow.AuthoringRequest)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{flow.StudentID, flow.LearningPathID, "mastery", "profile", "sandbox"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(encoded), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("authoring request leaked %q: %s", forbidden, encoded)
		}
	}
	now := flow.CreatedAt.Add(time.Minute)
	flow.ConfirmationIdempotencyKey = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	flow.ConfirmationDigest, _ = ProjectConfirmationDigest(flow)
	flow.ConfirmedAt = &now
	flow.Status = ProjectAuthoringConfirmed
	flow.Version++
	flow.UpdatedAt = now
	if _, err := NormalizeProjectAuthoringFlow(flow); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("confirmed: %v", err)
	}
	flow.Status = ProjectAuthoringAuthoring
	flow.Version++
	if _, err := NormalizeProjectAuthoringFlow(flow); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("authoring before TZ checkpoint: %v", err)
	}
	flow.TZAuthoringJobID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	flow.TZJobStatus = TZAuthoringReady
	flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest = digestOf("a")
	flow.ReadyCandidateDigest = digestOf("b")
	flow.ReadyContractDigest = digestOf("c")
	flow.ReadyCapabilitiesDigest = digestOf("d")
	flow.ReadyVerificationDigest = digestOf("e")
	flow.ReadyAt = &now
	flow.Status = ProjectAuthoringReady
	flow.Version++
	if _, err := NormalizeProjectAuthoringFlow(flow); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ready: %v", err)
	}
	withoutExplicitPublish := flow
	withoutExplicitPublish.Status = ProjectAuthoringPublished
	if _, err := NormalizeProjectAuthoringFlow(withoutExplicitPublish); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("READY became PUBLISHED without explicit publication receipt")
	}
	flow.PublicationIdempotencyKey = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	flow.PublicationRequestDigest, _ = ProjectPublicationRequestDigest(flow)
	flow.PublicationRequestedAt = &now
	receipt := ProjectPublicationReceiptV1{
		Schema: TZPublicationResultSchemaV1, RevisionID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		FamilyKey: "go-project", VariantKey: "default", RevisionNumber: 1,
		BlueprintDigest: flow.ReadyBlueprintDigest, CandidateDigest: flow.ReadyCandidateDigest,
		ContractDigest: flow.ReadyContractDigest, CapabilitiesDigest: flow.ReadyCapabilitiesDigest,
		AuthoringJobID: flow.TZAuthoringJobID,
	}
	flow.Publication = &receipt
	flow.PublicationReceiptDigest, _ = ProjectPublicationReceiptDigest(receipt)
	flow.PublishedAt = &now
	flow.Status = ProjectAuthoringPublished
	flow.Version++
	if _, err := NormalizeProjectAuthoringFlow(flow); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("published: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringOwnerSnapshotRejectsStalePathAndCorruptImmutableInput(t *testing.T) {
	flow := projectAuthoringFlowFixture(t)
	profile, path := projectAuthoringOwnerFixture()
	if err := ValidateProjectOwnerSnapshot(flow, profile, path); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid owner snapshot: %v", err)
	}
	path.PathVersion++
	if err := ValidateProjectOwnerSnapshot(flow, profile, path); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed path version was accepted")
	}
	corrupt := flow
	corrupt.Input.Targets[0].Key = "go.changed"
	if _, err := NormalizeProjectAuthoringFlow(corrupt); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed immutable authoring input retained its digest")
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringOwnerSnapshotRejectsChangedAuthoringProfileWithUnchangedPath(t *testing.T) {
	flow := projectAuthoringFlowFixture(t)
	profile, path := projectAuthoringOwnerFixture()

	languageChanged := profile
	languageChanged.PreferredLanguage = "en"
	languageChanged.OnboardingVersion++
	if err := ValidateProjectOwnerSnapshot(flow, languageChanged, path); err != ErrConflict {
		t.Fatalf("changed authoring locale err=%v, want conflict", err)
	}

	stacksChanged := profile
	stacksChanged.DesiredStacks = []string{"go", "postgresql"}
	stacksChanged.OnboardingVersion++
	if err := ValidateProjectOwnerSnapshot(flow, stacksChanged, path); err != ErrConflict {
		t.Fatalf("changed desired stacks err=%v, want conflict", err)
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringProfileDigestIsCanonicalAndBoundsTZStackCodes(t *testing.T) {
	profile, path := projectAuthoringOwnerFixture()
	profile.DesiredStacks = []string{" JavaScript ", "js", "Golang"}
	flow, err := NewProjectAuthoringFlow(
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", path.StudentID, path.LearningPathID,
		"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", profile, path,
		time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if strings.Join(flow.Input.Stacks, ",") != "go,javascript" {
		t.Fatalf("canonical stacks=%v", flow.Input.Stacks)
	}
	replay := profile
	replay.DesiredStacks = []string{"golang", "ecmascript"}
	replayDigest, err := ProjectAuthoringProfileDigest(replay)
	if err != nil || replayDigest != flow.AuthoringProfileDigest {
		t.Fatalf("canonical replay digest=%q err=%v, want %q", replayDigest, err, flow.AuthoringProfileDigest)
	}
	unrelated := profile
	unrelated.KnownStacks = []string{"rust"}
	unrelated.WeeklyMinutes = 480
	unrelated.PreferredPace = "intensive"
	unrelatedDigest, err := ProjectAuthoringProfileDigest(unrelated)
	if err != nil || unrelatedDigest != flow.AuthoringProfileDigest {
		t.Fatalf("unrelated fields entered authoring digest=%q err=%v, want %q", unrelatedDigest, err, flow.AuthoringProfileDigest)
	}
	tooLong := profile
	tooLong.DesiredStacks = []string{strings.Repeat("x", 65)}
	if _, err := NewProjectAuthoringFlow(
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", path.StudentID, path.LearningPathID,
		"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", tooLong, path,
		time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	); err != ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("65-byte TZ stack err=%v, want validation", err)
	}
}

func projectAuthoringFlowFixture(t *testing.T) ProjectAuthoringFlow {
	t.Helper()
	profile, path := projectAuthoringOwnerFixture()
	flow, err := NewProjectAuthoringFlow(
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", path.StudentID, path.LearningPathID,
		"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", profile, path,
		time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return flow
}

func projectAuthoringOwnerFixture() (StudentPlanningProfile, LearningPathPlanningState) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 11, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	studentID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	pathID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	courseID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	profile := StudentPlanningProfile{
		DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "junior", KnownStacks: []string{"sql"},
		DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "go.backend", PreferredLanguage: "ru",
		WeeklyMinutes: 240, PreferredPace: "standard", ProfileVersion: StudentPlanningProfileVersion,
		OnboardingVersion: 2, LearningPathVersion: 7, LearningPathCourseID: courseID,
		LearningPathGoalCode: "go.backend", LearningPathRevision: "course-fingerprint-v1",
	}
	path := LearningPathPlanningState{
		Schema: LearningPathPlanningStateSchema, StudentID: studentID, LearningPathID: pathID,
		CourseID: courseID, GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "course-fingerprint-v1",
		Status: "ACTIVE", IsPrimary: true, IsSelected: true, PathVersion: 7, JourneyVersion: 9,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "initial",
		Items:     []LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, Targets: []TargetRef{{Type: TargetCapability, Key: "go.http", Version: "v1"}}, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap"}},
		UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	return profile, path
}

func digestOf(character string) string { return "sha256:" + strings.Repeat(character, 64) }
